name: Anastasia Lynzel
original_name: アナスタシア・リンゼル
source:
[i]“I won't give up on myself ever again.”[/i]

[i]Crimson Soul on the Wheel of Fortune[/i]

A girl who has had to deal with her stepmother's cruelty since childhood. A musty attic room was once her whole world, but that all changed when she gained the ability to change the past with the Fatal Rewind.

This unusual ability dyes her fate crimson and raises the curtain on a new manner of tragedy.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=anastasia]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
